minutes_text:
74-273

  Minutes
  Monterey Park City Council
  Special Community Meeting
  June 24, 2026

The City Council of the City of Monterey Park held a Special Community Meeting of the
Council at the Langley Senior Center, Friendship Room located at 400. West Emerson
Ave, Monterey Park, CA, 91754 on Wednesday, June 24, 2026 at 6:00 p.m.

1.  Call to Order
  City Manager Inez Alvarez called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m.

2.  Roll Call
  City Manager Alvarez called the roll:

  Council Members Present: Henry Lo, Vinh Ngo, Jose Sanchez arrived at 6:18
  p.m., Thomas Wong arrived at 6:26 p.m., Elizabeth Yang
  Council Members Absent: None

  Also Present:
  Assistant City Manager Diana Garcia
  Director of Community Development Timothy Hou
  Director of Recreation and Community Services Robert Aguirre
  Director of Finance Martha Garcia
  Director of Human Resources and Risk Management
  Director of Public Works Shawn Igoe
  Fire Chief Jason Hing
  Economic Development Manager Joseph Torres
  Planning Manager Jerry Guevara
  Finance Manager Laura Borjon
  Principal Management Analyst Rebecca Bojorquez
  Senior Planner Eliana Muñoz
  Deputy City Clerk Cindy Trang
  Code Enforcement Supervisor Rey Lozano
  Planning Permit Technician I Nikole Sanchez

3.  Vacant to Vibrant Community Idea Workshop

  I. Welcome

  II. Vacant-to-Vibrant Land Use Presentation
  Senior Business Analyst Dana Sovinec and CEO/President Ryder Smith of
  Tripepi Smith provided a PowerPoint presentation on the City’s intention to
  engage with the residents regarding issues of housing and economic
  development and ideate on opportunities for development.

  Mission Statement
 The mission of the City of Monterey Park is to provide excellent service, foster growth
  and opportunity, and create a joyous and collaborative environment.
   74-274
  June 24, 2026
III. Small Group Discussion
Community Members engaged in a discussion regarding economic opportunities
to help grow Monterey Park.

IV. Question and Answer Session

V. Adjournment
Council Member Sanchez left the meeting at 7:20 p.m. and did not return.

There being no further business for consideration, the meeting was adjourned at
8:21 p.m.

_________________
Maychelle Yee
City Clerk

  Approved on August 19, 2026 at the regular City Council Meeting
